evals.prompt: search alphaxiv for recent papers on using GRPO-style reinforcement learning to fine-tune vision-language-action models for robotics
evals.expected_output: Calls the current discover_papers tool (not a retired tool name) with a keywords array, a semantic question string, and a difficulty number, then returns a ranked list of real candidate papers.
expectations: discover_papers call includes a keywords array (3-4 terms)
discover_papers call includes a question string (semantic description)
discover_papers call includes a difficulty number
No tool-call error surfaces to the final answer

evals.prompt: can you check the FlashSAC paper (arxiv 2604.04539) and tell me what update-to-data ratio and batch size it uses, plus what the entropy target is
evals.expected_output: Calls answer_pdf_queries once with paper="2604.04539" and a queries array batching all three questions, and returns correct values (UTD 2/1024 or 2/2048 depending on table, batch size 2048, entropy target sigma_tgt=0.15).
expectations: Calls mcp__alphaxiv__answer_pdf_queries with param name 'queries' as an array (not a single 'query' string)
All three questions are batched into one answer_pdf_queries call, not three separate calls
Final answer states entropy target / sigma_tgt around 0.15

evals.prompt: get me the training loop code from the LoRA (low-rank adaptation) paper's official repo - I want to see how they apply the low-rank update during the forward pass
evals.expected_output: Finds the paper and its GitHub URL (microsoft/LoRA), then uses read_files_from_github_repository starting with path="/" for an overview before drilling into the relevant source file.
expectations: Identifies the correct GitHub repo (microsoft/LoRA or equivalent official repo)
Calls mcp__alphaxiv__read_files_from_github_repository with path="/" at least once before drilling into a specific file
Eventually reads a specific source file relevant to the low-rank forward pass, not just the repo root
No tool-call error surfaces to the final answer
